eb92b70d9c02f7d9c21a630036cf7699371c4e7b.summary: A new Telegram channel combining the names Shiny Hunters, Scattered Spider and Lapsus$ posted partial leaks, claimed breaches and data-sale offers within 24 hours. Posts tied past incidents to the Snowflake and Salesforce campaigns and targeted UK, US and other government bodies. The group threatened the UK Ministry of Justice, teased ransomware, and demanded 20 bitcoins from Salesforce's CEO. The report calls the posts impulsive and the list incomplete.
